movie_title: The History and Future of Everything -- Time
introduction:
How much time do you have left?

Time makes sense in small pieces. But when you look at huge stretch
lead_intro: Have you ever thought about the vastness of time and how it shapes our history? Let's journey through time together and test your knowledge!

quiz.question: When did the agricultural revolution take place?
quiz.explanation: The agricultural revolution took place about 12,000 years ago, leading to the rise of farming, cities, and larger communities.

quiz.question: How long ago did the universe begin?
quiz.explanation: The universe was born 13,750,000,000 years ago, with our own galaxy forming 600,000,000 years later.

quiz.question: Which event marked the end of the dinosaurs' reign on Earth?
quiz.explanation: The age of the dinosaurs ended around 65,000,000 years ago in an enormous explosion, paving the way for the rise of mammals.

quiz.question: When did Homo sapiens, the modern human, evolve?
quiz.explanation: Homo sapiens, the modern human, evolved 200,000 years ago, marking a significant point in human history.

quiz.question: How long ago did life on Earth consist only of tiny microbes and single-cell bacteria?
quiz.explanation: For 2,400,000,000 years, life on Earth consisted only of tiny microbes and single-cell bacteria before evolving into more complex life forms.
